body:
Adds `research/ladder-twin`: how to split a simulation budget across a ladder of twin timestep fidelities (multilevel Monte Carlo). Exact level biases and variances; a smooth quantity saves 3.6x-897x steps, while a failure-indicator quantity has beta=gamma so multilevel loses at loose targets (0.4x) and reaches 7.7x at 1e-4. Includes README, whitepaper, 10 tests, results, README bullet and site entry (`python site/build.py` prints ok).
